drills.title: Follow the Pass
drills.subtitle: Pass, follow your pass to that spot. Catch it at cone 3, drive and shoot.
drills.blurb: Full ice, two-sided. Lines along each goal line; the front player at the boards passes first. Catch at cone 3, drive, shoot, and join the other line.
drills.diagramAlt: Full-ice diagram of Follow the Pass. Lines sit on both goal lines, three cones mark each side, and the flow ends with a shot before joining the far line.
coachingPoints: Full ice and two-sided. Both ends run at the same time.
The front player starts at the boards and makes the first pass.
Three cones per side: near blue line at centre, boards at the red line, far blue line at centre.
Catch the puck at cone 3, drive the net, and shoot. Then join the line at the other end.
steps: Set a line along each goal line. The first player in each line starts on the boards with a puck.
Place three cones on each side of the rink: centre ice at the near blue line, on the boards at the red line, and centre ice at the far blue line.
The front player passes to the next player in line, then follows that pass along the cones.
Each player who receives the puck passes it on and follows their own pass. Keep the puck and the skaters moving up the ice.
The player who catches the puck at cone 3 (far blue line, centre) drives the net and shoots.
After the shot, that player joins the line at the far end. The same pattern is already coming back the other way.

drills.title: Low-to-High: D Shot
drills.subtitle: Carry in, drive to the dot, curl, pass up to the D. D shoots.
drills.blurb: Half-ice zone entry. Carry in, drive to the dot, curl toward the boards, and pass up to the D. The D shoots and the forward drives the net.
drills.diagramAlt: Half-ice diagram of Low-to-High D Shot. The forward curls at the dot, passes up the wall to the defence, the defence shoots, and the forward drives the net.
coachingPoints: Half-ice zone entry with one defence inside the blue line.
Carry in with speed, drive to the faceoff dot, then curl toward the boards.
The pass is low-to-high: from the curl, up the wall, onto the defence.
Defence shoots. The forward drives the net front, then returns to the line.
steps: Forwards line up just outside the blue line with pucks. One defence stands inside the blue line, on the boards side of the entry.
Carry the puck over the blue line and drive toward the faceoff dot.
At the dot, curl toward the boards so you are looking back up the wall.
Pass low-to-high, up the boards, to the defence.
The defence catches and shoots. Drive to the front of the net for a tip or a rebound.
Leave the net and return to the back of the line. The next forward goes.

drills.title: Low-to-High: Give-and-Go
drills.subtitle: Carry in, drive to the dot, curl, pass up to the D. Give-and-go.
drills.blurb: Same zone entry. After the low-to-high pass, the D gives it back to the forward cutting the slot, and the forward shoots.
drills.diagramAlt: Half-ice diagram of the low-to-high give-and-go. The forward passes up to the defence, cuts to the slot, takes the return pass, and shoots.
coachingPoints: Use the same entry as D Shot: carry, dot, curl, pass up the wall.
The forward leaves as the pass goes. The cut to the slot starts with the pass.
Defence returns the puck. One touch back if it is there.
The forward shoots from the slot, then returns to the line.
steps: Set it up like Low-to-High: D Shot. Forwards outside the blue line, one defence inside on the strong-side wall.
Carry in, drive to the faceoff dot, and curl toward the boards.
Pass low-to-high to the defence.
As soon as the pass leaves your stick, cut to the slot.
Defence passes the puck back to the forward on that cut.
The forward shoots, then returns to the back of the line.

drills.title: Low-to-High: D-to-D
drills.subtitle: Carry in, drive to the dot, curl, pass up to the D. D-to-D, shot.
drills.blurb: Same zone entry. The bottom D passes across to the top D, the top D shoots, and the forward screens.
drills.diagramAlt: Half-ice diagram of low-to-high D-to-D. The forward passes to the bottom defence, the puck goes across to the top defence for a shot, and the forward screens.
coachingPoints: Same forward entry, with two defence on the ice.
Bottom D is on the strong-side wall and moves the puck. Top D is across the blue line and shoots.
The D-to-D pass stays up near the blue line, firm and flat.
The forward screens the goalie, stick on the ice, then clears the front.
steps: Forwards line up outside the blue line with pucks. Bottom defence stands inside the blue line on the boards side of the entry. Top defence stands on the far side of the blue line.
Carry in, drive to the faceoff dot, and curl toward the boards.
Pass low-to-high to the bottom defence.
Bottom defence passes across the blue line to the top defence.
Top defence shoots. The forward drives the net and screens the goalie.
Clear the front of the net and return to the back of the line.

drills.title: 1 Up / 1 Down
drills.subtitle: Gap and angling 1v1. D touches the goal line, F touches the blue line, then play it out.
drills.blurb: Corner 1v1. On 'Go' the D touches the goal line and the F touches the blue line. The coach puts the puck in, the F attacks for a shot and a rebound, and the D gaps up and angles.
drills.diagramAlt: Zone diagram of 1 Up / 1 Down. The defence skates to the goal line, the forward skates to the blue line, the coach passes to the forward, the forward attacks and shoots while the defence closes the gap and angles.
coachingPoints: Use all four corners. Corners that share a net take turns.
D: head up before you turn up ice, close the gap, and lead with your stick to steer the forward to the outside.
F: look before you turn to attack, use speed and fakes, and protect the puck on the way to the net.
F gets one shot and one rebound. If the D steals it, clear it or skate it past the top of the circles.
steps: Set a forward line and a defence line in the corner. The coach stands near the top of the circle with pucks.
On the coach's 'Go', the D skates down and touches the goal line while the F skates up and touches the blue line.
The coach puts the puck in to the forward.
The forward attacks the net. The D steps up, closes the gap, and angles the forward to the outside.
The forward gets one shot and one rebound. If the D wins the puck, they clear it or skate it past the top of the circles.
Flip roles: the forward joins the D line and the D joins the F line. Halfway through, swap corners for new matchups.

drills.title: Olympic Breakout Pass
drills.subtitle: F to X, pivot on the wall, give-and-go across to O, curl to the slot for a one-timer.
drills.blurb: Continuous groups of three in one zone. F passes low to X, pivots on the wall, takes it back, one-touches across to O, and curls into the slot for a one-timer from X.
drills.diagramAlt: Zone diagram of the Olympic Breakout Pass. The forward passes to X low, skates down the wall, gets the puck back, passes across to O at the top of the circle, curls over the top into the slot, and one-times a feed from X.
coachingPoints: Groups of three: F with the puck near the blue line, X low support, O high support at the top of the circle.
Pivot tight to the boards below the hash marks and show a target for the return pass.
Make the pass across to O on one touch, then curl over the top of the circle into the slot.
Keep it moving with no whistles. Rotate F to O, O to X, and X to the line.
steps: F starts near the blue line with the puck. X stands low at the bottom of the faceoff circle and O stands high at the top of the circle.
F passes to X and skates tight down the boards.
F pivots below the hash marks and X passes the puck back.
F one-touches the puck across to O, then curls over the top of the circle.
O passes down to X while F cuts into the slot.
X feeds F in the slot for a one-timer on goal.
Rotate: F takes O's spot, O takes X's spot, and X goes to the back of the line. The next F goes right away.

drills.title: Zone Exits: Bounce Pass
drills.subtitle: Bounce a self-pass off the boards around a cone, then a soft D, then a stretch pass past the D.
drills.blurb: Defensive-zone exits from a line in each corner. Start with a self-pass off the boards around a cone, swap the cone for a coach as a soft D, then finish with a bounce stretch pass to a teammate past the D holding the line.
drills.diagramAlt: Zone diagram of the zone-exit bounce pass progression. In the bottom corner a player carries up the wall, banks the puck past a cone, and exits. In the top corner a player carries up the wall and banks a stretch pass past the coach at the point to a teammate at the blue line.
coachingPoints: Progression 1: bank the puck off the boards past a cone, skate around it, and pick it up.
Progression 2: replace the cone with a coach as a soft D. Same self-pass, now with pressure.
Progression 3: bounce a stretch pass off the boards to a teammate for the exit.
Pick the angle and weight so the D holding the blue line can't pick the pass off.
steps: Set a line in each corner on the goal line with pucks. Place a cone low on one wall. A coach stands at the point on the other side.
The first player carries up the wall toward the cone.
Bank the puck off the boards past the cone, skate around the inside of the cone, pick it up, and exit over the blue line.
Progression 2: the coach replaces the cone as a soft defender. Bounce it past them the same way.
Progression 3: the player in the other corner carries up the wall while a teammate swings to the boards at the blue line.
Bank a stretch pass off the boards past the D to the teammate, who carries it out.
Players switch lines and the next pair goes.

drills.title: Tip-and-Dig Shooting
drills.subtitle: Tip the point shot into the empty net, dig it out, and shoot on the goalie.
drills.blurb: Zone shooting with two nets: an empty net at the hash marks and the regular net with a goalie. Tip the point shot into the empty net, dig it out, and shoot on the goalie.
drills.diagramAlt: Zone diagram of Tip-and-Dig Shooting. A shooter at the blue line shoots through a tipper standing in front of an empty net at the hash marks. The tipper digs the puck out and carries into the slot to shoot on the goalie.
coachingPoints: Put an empty net at the hash marks. The goalie stays in the regular net on the goal line.
Tipper: stick on the ice and redirect the point shot into the empty net.
Dig the puck out of the net quickly, then attack the slot and shoot on the goalie.
Run it in both corners at the same time if you have the ice.
steps: Place an empty net at the hash marks. One player stands in front of it as the tipper. The shooters line up at the blue line with pucks.
The first shooter shoots from the blue line and the tipper deflects it into the empty net.
The tipper digs the puck out of the empty net while the shooter moves in to become the next tipper.
The tipper carries into the slot and shoots on the goalie.
After the shot, go to the back of the shooting line. The next shooter goes.

drills.title: 4-Lane Warm-up
drills.subtitle: One line in the corner. Lane 1 inside edges, lane 2 crossovers, lanes 3 and 4 carry the puck and shoot.
drills.blurb: Full-ice warm-up. Cones split the ice into four lanes and one line starts in the corner. Skate lane 1 on inside edges, lane 2 with crossovers, then carry a puck two-handed in lane 3 and one-handed in lane 4, with a shot at the end of each.
drills.diagramAlt: Full-ice diagram of the 4-Lane Warm-up. Three rows of cones split the ice into four lanes. A skater goes down lane 1, back up lane 2, carries a puck down lane 3 to shoot on the far net, and carries back up lane 4 to shoot on the near net.
coachingPoints: Three rows of cones split the ice into four lanes. One line starts in the corner.
Lane 1: inside edges, no crossovers. Lane 2: outside edges with crossovers.
Lane 3: two hands on the stick, carry and shoot. Lane 4: one-handed carry, then shoot.
Send the next player when the one ahead reaches the first cones.
steps: Set three rows of cones the length of the ice to make four lanes. The line starts in the corner. Put pucks at each end.
Lane 1: skate down the ice on inside edges with no crossovers.
Lane 2: come back up the next lane using outside edges and crossovers.
Lane 3: pick up a puck, carry it two-handed down the lane, and shoot on the far net.
Lane 4: pick up a puck, carry it one-handed back up the last lane, and shoot on the near net.
Return to the line in the corner and repeat.

drills.title: Crossover Circles
drills.subtitle: Crossovers around the faceoff circles: 5 forwards, 5 backwards, then the same with pucks.
drills.blurb: A skating warm-up on the faceoff circles. Skaters do crossovers around the circle forwards, then backwards the other way, then repeat the set with a puck.
drills.diagramAlt: Zone diagram of Crossover Circles. A line of skaters at each end-zone faceoff circle skates around the circle forwards, then backwards the other way, then with a puck, and returns to the line.
coachingPoints: Knees bent and chest up. Push with the outside leg and cross the inside leg over.
Lean into the circle and keep your stick on the ice.
Backwards: stay low, keep your shoulders square, and push with the crossunder.
With pucks: keep your head up and the puck out in front.
steps: Split into one group per faceoff circle, lined up at the edge of the circle. Pucks sit behind the line.
Skate 5 circles forwards with crossovers.
Skate 5 circles backwards, going the other way.
Grab a puck and do the same again: 5 forwards, then 5 backwards.
Back to the line. The front of the line goes next.

drills.title: Stops and Starts
drills.subtitle: Goal line to far blue, stop, back to near blue, stop, then to the far dots. No pucks first, then with pucks.
drills.blurb: Waves of skaters start on the goal line, sprint to the far blue line, stop hard, sprint back to the near blue line, stop, then finish at the far end-zone dots. The far net stays free for the goalies.
drills.diagramAlt: Full-ice diagram of Stops and Starts. Three skaters on the left goal line sprint to the far blue line, skate back to the near blue line, then sprint to the far faceoff dots, with a goalie in the right net.
coachingPoints: Hard two-foot stops: knees bent, weight on the edges, shoulders level.
Explode out of each stop with short, quick first strides.
Stop facing the same way each time, then switch sides on the next rep.
With pucks: keep the puck close through the stop and the restart.
steps: Skaters start in waves on the goal line.
Sprint to the far blue line and stop hard.
Sprint back to the near blue line and stop hard.
Sprint to the far faceoff dots and stop. Leave the net end free for the goalies.
Run it without pucks first, then the same with pucks.

drills.title: Edges: Cone Weave
drills.subtitle: Weave through a lane of cones from the blue line to the goal line on your edges. Theme: balance and edge work.
drills.blurb: Three or four lanes of cones run from the blue line to the goal line. Skaters weave through their lane on deep edges, then return up the outside to their line.
drills.diagramAlt: Zone diagram of Edges: Cone Weave. Four lines start at the blue line and weave through lanes of five cones toward the goal line, then skate back up the outside.
coachingPoints: Long strides on one foot: glide and hold the edge round each cone.
Knees bent and weight over the skate you are on.
Inside and outside edges both: carve, don't step round the cone.
Head up, eyes on the next cone.
steps: Set up 3 or 4 lanes of cones from the blue line to the goal line.
The front of each line weaves through the cones on deep edges.
At the goal line, skate back up the outside to your line.
The next skater goes as soon as the one ahead passes the second cone.

drills.title: Lateral Step-overs with Pivots
drills.subtitle: Sideways crossover step-overs down a lane of cones, pivoting 180 degrees at each cone.
drills.blurb: Skaters move sideways down a lane with crossover step-overs, pivoting at each cone so they face the benches, then away from the benches, then the benches again.
drills.diagramAlt: Zone diagram of Lateral Step-overs with Pivots. Three lines move sideways from the blue line toward the goal line, stepping over to each of three cones and pivoting at each one.
coachingPoints: Stay low and step the trailing leg over the lead leg.
Shoulders and hips stay square to the way you are facing.
Quick, tight pivots at each cone: don't drift past it.
Keep your stick on the ice in front of you.
steps: Set up lanes of cones from the blue line to the goal line.
Step over sideways to the first cone, facing the benches.
Pivot and step over to the second cone, facing away from the benches.
Pivot and step over to the third cone, facing the benches again.
Skate back up the outside to your line.

drills.title: Cone Relay with Pucks
drills.subtitle: Relay race: at each cone, one pass and catch with your line. Alternate forwards (tight turn) and backwards (pivot).
drills.blurb: Three or four lines race at once, each with 3 or 4 cones. At each cone the skater makes one pass to the next player in line and gets it back, alternating forwards with tight turns and backwards with pivots.
drills.diagramAlt: Zone diagram of Cone Relay with Pucks. The middle lane is drawn: the skater carries forwards to cone 1 with a tight turn, passes to the line and gets it back, skates backwards to cone 2, then forwards to cone 3, and races back to hand off.
coachingPoints: Tight turns: get low, lean in, and keep the puck on the inside.
Pivot without stopping your feet.
Firm, flat passes. Show a target with your stick for the return.
Race, but stay in control: a missed pass costs more time than a slower turn.
steps: Set up 3 or 4 lines with 3 or 4 cones in each lane.
Carry the puck forwards to cone 1 and make a tight turn.
Pass to the next player in your line and get it back, pivot, and skate backwards to cone 2.
Pass and catch again, then go forwards to cone 3 with a tight turn.
Pass and catch, race back, and hand the puck to the next player. First line done wins.

drills.title: 2v2 Point Shot Small Area Game
drills.subtitle: 2 on 2 in a corner with a point player. Dump in, battle, use the point for shots, regroup on a turnover.
drills.blurb: Groups of five at each corner net: 2 O, 2 D and a point player. The point dumps the puck in and the 2v2 starts. The team with the puck can use the point for shots. On a change of possession, regroup up to the point.
drills.diagramAlt: Zone diagram of 2v2 Point Shot. The point player dumps the puck into the corner, an O player wins it and carries up the wall, passes to the point, and the point shoots on the corner net while the other O goes to the net.
coachingPoints: Win the race to the puck and protect it along the wall.
Use the point: move it up, then get to the net for tips and rebounds.
On a turnover, regroup to the point before you attack.
D: stick on puck, body on body, and clear the front of the net.
steps: Put a net in each corner. Groups of 5 per net: 2 O, 2 D and 1 point player (or a coach at the point with groups of 4).
The point dumps the puck into the corner and the 2v2 starts.
The team with the puck can pass up to the point for a shot.
On a change of possession, move the puck up to the point before attacking.
Goal or 60 seconds: O and D swap. Each group gets 1 turn on O, 1 on D and 1 rest.

drills.title: 2v2 Hard Rim
drills.subtitle: Rim it hard around the boards to your partner, then 2 on 2. D must touch the top of the circle first.
drills.blurb: Two lines of forwards with pucks at the hash marks and two D at the dots. The first forward rims the puck hard behind the net to the partner on the far wall, and it's 2 on 2. The D must touch the top of the circle before they can defend.
drills.diagramAlt: Zone diagram of 2v2 Hard Rim. The top forward rims the puck around the boards behind the net to the bottom forward while the two D skate to the top of the circles. The bottom forward collects, passes to the partner, and the partner shoots.
coachingPoints: Rim it hard and high on the glass side so it gets all the way around.
Receiver: get to the wall early, stop the puck with your skate or stick, and look up.
D: touch the top of the circle, then attack fast and take away the middle.
Play it out: second chances and rebounds count.
steps: Two lines of forwards with pucks at the hash marks on each wall. Two D start at the dots.
The first forward rims the puck hard behind the net to the forward at the front of the other line.
The D must skate up and touch the top of the circle before they can play.
The forwards play 2 on 2 to the net.
If the D win the puck, they pass or rim it to the next pair in line. Then the D go out and the O become D.
Start from the blue line for longer rims. Run the same drill on the other side of the ice.

drills.title: 3v3 Circle Game
drills.subtitle: 3 on 3 at a faceoff circle with two nets. Only one player per team inside the circle.
drills.blurb: Two nets face each other inside a faceoff circle. It's 3 on 3, but only one player per team can be inside the circle. Outside players try to work a pass into their inside player, and they can shoot too.
drills.diagramAlt: Zone diagram of 3v3 Circle Game. Two nets with goalies face each other across a faceoff circle. The coach passes to an outside X player, the X players move it around the outside, pass to the inside X, and the inside X shoots.
coachingPoints: Inside player: get open, stick on the ice, and be ready for a quick shot or a tip.
Outside players: move the puck quickly and look for the inside pass first.
Drive the post and fight for net-front position.
Only one player per team in the circle at a time.
steps: Put two nets facing each other inside a faceoff circle, with a goalie in each.
Three per team: one inside the circle, two outside. Only one player per team may be inside.
The coach puts a puck in.
Outside players pass it around and try to get it to their inside player. They can shoot too.
Play short shifts and change on the coach's whistle. Optional, if time allows.

drills.title: Half-ice 3v3
drills.subtitle: O tries to score. D must win the puck AND pass it to the coach at the blue line. Then O flips to D, fresh 3 on O.
drills.blurb: 3 on 3 in half the ice. The O try to score. The D try to win the puck and pass it to the coach at the blue line. Then the D come off, the O flip to D, and three fresh skaters come on as O.
drills.diagramAlt: Half-ice diagram of Half-ice 3v3. The O carry in and pass to a teammate in the slot, who shoots. A D player wins the rebound, passes to a teammate, who passes to the coach at the blue line. The D then go to the waiting line.
coachingPoints: O: support the puck carrier and get someone to the net.
D: win the puck, then move it quickly and with control to the coach.
Talk: who has the puck carrier, who has the net front.
Change fast so the next group can start right away.
steps: Use each half of the ice with a net in its normal spot. The coach stands at the blue line.
3 O try to score on 3 D.
The D must win the puck and pass it to the coach.
When the coach has the puck, the D come off, the O flip to D, and 3 fresh skaters come on as O.
Progression: all 3 D must touch the puck before passing to the coach.

drills.title: Defend the Cone
drills.subtitle: 1 on 1 at a faceoff circle: the attacker tries to touch the cone at the dot, the defender keeps body position.
drills.blurb: A backup when you run out of nets: defend a cone instead. 1 on 1 around a faceoff circle with a cone on the dot. The attacker tries to touch the cone with the puck; the defender stays between the attacker and the cone.
drills.diagramAlt: Zone diagram of Defend the Cone. An attacker carries the puck around the faceoff circle while the defender mirrors from inside, then the attacker cuts in for the cone at the dot and the defender angles them away.
coachingPoints: Defender: stay between the attacker and the cone, stick on the puck.
Use your angle, not a reach. Keep your feet moving.
Attacker: protect the puck with your body and change speed to get inside.
Variations: with or without a puck, with or without sticks.
steps: Put a cone on the faceoff dot. One line of attackers and one line of defenders.
The attacker carries the puck around the circle. The defender mirrors from inside.
The attacker cuts in and tries to touch the cone with the puck. The defender angles them away.
Swap: the attacker joins the defender line and the defender joins the attack line.

drills.title: 1-on-1 Shooting Warm-up to 2-on-1
drills.subtitle: Lines in opposite corners. Skate hard, take a pass from the far corner, go in and shoot. The passer goes next. Progress to a 2-on-1.
drills.blurb: A full-ice shooting warm-up. Lines start in opposite corners. A player leaves one corner skating hard, gets a hard pass from the front of the far line, goes in and shoots. The passer then leaves and gets a pass from the other corner. Progression: a 2-on-1 off the same pattern.
drills.diagramAlt: Full-ice diagram of 1-on-1 Shooting Warm-up. Lines sit in the bottom-left and top-right corners. The left player skates up the middle, takes a pass from the right corner, carries in and shoots on the right goalie. Then the right player skates out, takes a pass from the left corner, and shoots on the left goalie. Shooters join the line in the corner they shot from.
coachingPoints: Skate hard out of the corner and show a target with your stick.
Passer: hard, flat pass in front of the skater, not at their feet.
Catch it in stride and keep your feet moving into the zone.
Shoot to score, then follow it for the rebound.
2-on-1: the D has a head start; the F's go when the D reaches the blue line.
steps: Split the group into two lines in opposite corners, with pucks at each line. A goalie in each net.
The front of one line skates hard out of the corner. The front of the far line hits them with a hard pass.
The skater carries in and shoots on the far goalie, then joins the line in that corner.
The passer goes next: skate out and take a pass from the other corner, then go in and shoot.

Progression (2-on-1): send three players toward centre. The leader is a D with a head start; the F's go when the D reaches the blue line. The D takes the pass and drops it to an F, then it's a 2-on-1 the other way.

drills.title: Mirror Angling 2v1
drills.subtitle: F loops the cones while the D mirrors around the dot, then a quick 2v1 rush. Both attackers drive the net.
drills.blurb: A half-ice station. The F carries a loop around the cones while the D mirrors around the cone at the faceoff dot, working on angling. Then a second F joins and it's a quick 2v1 on net. Both attackers drive the net; the puck carrier can pass, shoot or delay on the wall. Uses 2 D and 4-6 F.
drills.diagramAlt: Zone diagram of Mirror Angling 2v1. An F line at the top of the circle and an X line at the dot. The F loops cone 1 and rounds cone 2 toward the boards while the X mirrors around the cone below the dot and angles the carrier toward the wall. A second F drives the net, the carrier passes to them, and they shoot on the goalie.
coachingPoints: D: mirror the carrier, keep your stick on the ice, and angle them to the boards.
Close the gap with your feet, not a reach. Take away the middle.
F: protect the puck through the cones and keep your feet moving.
2v1: both attackers drive the net. Carrier reads the D: pass, shoot or delay on the wall.
Quick reps: one rush, then the next group.
steps: Set three cones: one below the faceoff dot for the D, and two by the F line. F's line up at the top of the circle with pucks; D's line up at the dot.
The F carries a loop around the first cone while the D pivots around the cone by the dot, mirroring the F.
The F rounds the second cone and cuts toward the net along the wall. The D angles them toward the boards.
A second F drives the net. It's 2v1: the carrier can pass, shoot or delay on the wall.
Play it out, then everyone returns to their line and the next group goes.

drills.title: 1v1 Puck Race to 2v1
drills.subtitle: Two players race for the puck. The winner attacks with a low-to-high pass; the loser defends the 2v1.
drills.blurb: Two players start side by side and race for a puck rimmed into the corner. The winner retrieves it and starts the attack with a low-to-high pass to a high player; the loser becomes the D. Then it's a 2v1 on net.
drills.diagramAlt: Zone diagram of 1v1 Puck Race to 2v1. A coach behind the net rims a puck into the corner. Two players start side by side near the net and race for it. The winner carries up the wall and passes low-to-high to a player at the top of the circle by a cone, who carries to the slot and shoots while the winner drives the net. The loser defends.
coachingPoints: Race: first three strides hard, and win body position on the puck.
Winner: protect the puck on the wall, then look up for the low-to-high pass.
High player: be ready, stick on the ice, and attack the net after the catch.
Loser: recover fast and defend the 2v1. Take away the pass and let the goalie have the shooter.
Attackers: drive the net for rebounds.
steps: Two players start side by side near the net. A high player waits at the top of the circle by a cone. The coach has pucks behind the net.
The coach rims a puck into the corner and both players race for it.
The winner retrieves the puck and carries up the wall.
The winner passes low-to-high to the high player.
The high player attacks and shoots while the winner drives the net. The loser defends the 2v1. Play it out, then the next pair goes.

drills.title: Rebounds: In-tight Hands
drills.subtitle: Small nets with a cone on each side. Bank the puck off the net, gather it in tight and shoot.
drills.blurb: A net-front station with small nets. Two cones sit on either side of the net. Facing the net, the player banks the puck off the net, gathers it in tight and shoots. A coach or the next player in line can bank it instead. 2-3 players per net.
drills.diagramAlt: Zone diagram of Rebounds: In-tight Hands. Small nets sit at the bottom of the faceoff circles with a cone on each side. The front of the line passes the puck off the post, skates in to gather it beside the net, and shoots into the small net, then returns to the back of the line.
coachingPoints: Soft hands: cushion the puck as it comes off the net.
Quick release in tight. Don't wind up.
Stay low with your stick on the ice, ready for the bounce.
Shoot to score: look for the open side, high or low.
Keep it moving: 2-3 players per net, lots of reps.
steps: Set up small nets with a cone on each side. 2-3 players per net, pucks at the line.
Facing the net, the front of the line banks the puck off the net (or a coach/partner banks it).
Gather the rebound in tight beside the net.
Shoot quickly into the small net.
Back of the line. The next player goes.

drills.title: Goalie Rebound Game
drills.subtitle: The coach shoots on one goalie. That goalie tries to steer the rebound into the other goalie's net.
drills.blurb: A goalie game for rebound control. Two nets sit side by side, each with a goalie. The coach shoots on one goalie, who tries to deflect the rebound into the other goalie's net. Switch nets after 5-10 shots and keep score.
drills.diagramAlt: Zone diagram of Goalie Rebound Game. Two nets sit side by side along the top of the zone, each with a goalie. The coach shoots from the circle at the right net, and that goalie steers the rebound toward the left net.
coachingPoints: Goalies: square up to the shooter and track the puck all the way in.
Control the rebound with your pads and stick. Steer it, don't just block it.
Recover fast: the other goalie can fire one back.
Coach: vary the shots (low to the pads, glove side, blocker side).
steps: Put two nets side by side, each with a goalie. The coach has pucks out front.
The coach shoots on one goalie.
That goalie tries to direct the rebound into the other goalie's net.
Alternate which goalie gets the shot.
Scoring: each goalie starts on 10. Lose 1 for a direct goal against you and 2 for a rebound steered into your net. First to 0 loses. Switch nets after 5-10 shots.

drills.title: Rondo Passing Progressions
drills.subtitle: Groups of 5-7 in a small circle: passers keep the puck away from a defender in the middle. Steal it and you swap.
drills.blurb: A small-area passing game. 4-5 passers around a 20x20 ft circle (a faceoff circle works) keep the puck away from 1-2 defenders in the middle. A defender who intercepts swaps with the passer. Rotate defenders every 30-60 seconds; points for 5+ passes in a row. Build it up through the progressions.
drills.diagramAlt: Zone diagram of Rondo Passing. Five passers stand around a faceoff circle with one X defender in the middle. The puck goes from passer to passer across and around the circle, and the X intercepts the fourth pass. The X then takes that passer's spot and the passer moves to the middle.
coachingPoints: Head up: know where your next pass is going before the puck arrives.
Quick, flat passes. Move the puck before the defender closes.
Show a target with your stick and give the passer an option.
Defender: take away the middle pass with your stick and body.
Count passes out loud: 5+ in a row scores a point.
steps: Groups of 5-7. 4-5 passers around a small circle (20x20 ft, or a faceoff circle) and 1-2 defenders in the middle.
Progression 1: pass around the circle with no defender.
Progression 2: one puck, follow your pass. Then two pucks, follow your pass.
Progression 3: one puck and one defender. If the defender intercepts, they swap with the passer.
Progression 4: two defenders, one puck. Rotate defenders every 30-60 seconds; 5+ passes in a row scores a point.

drills.title: Zone Entries: Delay
drills.subtitle: Carry in wide, delay on the wall, then attack (top) or hit a catcher streaking to the slot (bottom).
drills.blurb: Two delay variations of the zone entry. Delay: carry in wide, stop and curl back up the wall to buy time, then attack the net. Delay, low-to-slot (dynamic): carry in and delay, then hit a catcher streaking to the net for a catch-and-shoot from the slot. The other two variations in this progression match Low-to-High: Give-and-Go and Low-to-High: D-to-D. Can also be run in the neutral zone or on small ice.
drills.diagramAlt: Half-ice diagram of Zone Entries: Delay. Top: a forward carries wide over the blue line, curls back up the wall to delay, then cuts to the slot and shoots. Bottom: a forward carries wide and curls to delay while a catcher skates in from the neutral zone and streaks to the net; the carrier passes to the catcher, who shoots from the slot.
coachingPoints: Carry in wide with speed to push the D back.
Delay: stop and curl hard with the puck on your forehand, protecting it from the D.
Head up during the curl: look for the attack lane or the late player.
Catcher: time your streak so you hit the slot with speed, stick on the ice.
Pass to the stick in the slot; catch and shoot quickly.
steps: Lines of forwards with pucks at the boards in the neutral zone. For the low-to-slot variation, a catcher line waits in the middle.
Delay (top): carry in wide over the blue line.
Stop and curl back up the wall to delay.
Attack: cut to the slot and shoot.
Delay, low-to-slot (bottom): carry in wide and delay the same way. The catcher streaks to the net; the carrier passes to the slot and the catcher shoots.
The other two variations in this progression (delay, low-to-high to the slot; delay, low-to-high to the D) match Low-to-High: Give-and-Go and Low-to-High: D-to-D.
